facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology's Digital Economy Strategic Framework 2024-2034 sets, under consolidating and improving GovNet infrastructure, a target of 184 LGAs and 600 MDAs with installed structured LAN and connected to GovNet by June 2026, and a strategy to expand GovNet coverage to all LGA and MDA facilities with further targets to June 2029; these are targets, not a count of offices connected. No date is given beyond the framework's year, so its published year is used.

systems.tiers: Target: 184 LGAs and 600 MDAs by June 2026; all LGA and MDA facilities by June 2029
